tips.text: Radshare the Neuroptics, Chassis and Systems relics in a squad of four; solo Intact cracks waste them.
Leave the Blueprint relics Intact; Radiant lowers the Common drop odds.
Bank about 100 Aya ahead of time; it never expires and covers whatever Varzia stocks.
Do not open relic packs hoping for Protea Prime relics; packs never hold vaulted relics, only Aya.
Buy extra Chassis relics from Varzia; Chassis is the bottleneck.
Pick a teammate's identical reward on the reward screen; they get 5 bonus Void Traces.
In Disruption from round 4, let all but one or two conduits die to stay on the better reward table.
Players say radsharing is what separates a cheap farm from a long one; solo Intact cracking is the common regret.
Players call Aya double RNG when farmed on demand and fine when banked passively months ahead.
